replacements.before: Equilibrium. The controller is $u=\kappa(\rho-x)$, so $\dot x=-(1+\kappa)x+\kappa\rho+w$, and forward Euler with step $\Delta t$ gives the recursion above. Its fixed point solves $-(1+\kappa)x+\kappa\rho+w=0$, i.e. $x_{\rm eq}=(\kappa\rho+w)/(1+\kappa)$. Subtracting the fixed-point equation gives $x_{k+1}-x_{\rm eq}=r\,(x_k-x_{\rm eq})$ with $r=1-\Delta t(1+\kappa)\in[0.9775,0.99]$, hence $x_k=x_{\rm eq}+r^k(x_0-x_{\rm eq})$: the state moves monotonically from $x_0$ towards $x_{\rm eq}$ without reaching it. So $\sup_k|x_k|=\max(|x_0|,x_{\rm eq})$ and $g(a,x_0)=\inf_k\bar g(x_k)=1-\max(|x_0|,x_{\rm eq})$.
replacements.after: Equilibrium. The controller is $u=\kappa(\rho-x)$, so $\dot x=-(1+\kappa)x+\kappa\rho+w$, and forward Euler with step $\Delta t$ gives the recursion above. Its fixed point solves $-(1+\kappa)x+\kappa\rho+w=0$, i.e. $x_{\rm eq}=(\kappa\rho+w)/(1+\kappa)$. Subtracting the fixed-point equation gives $x_{k+1}-x_{\rm eq}=r\,(x_k-x_{\rm eq})$ with $r=1-\Delta t(1+\kappa)\in[0.9775,0.99]$, hence $x_k=x_{\rm eq}+r^k(x_0-x_{\rm eq})$: the state moves monotonically from $x_0$ towards $x_{\rm eq}$ without reaching it when $x_0\ne x_{\rm eq}$; if $x_0=x_{\rm eq}$, it stays fixed. So $\sup_k|x_k|=\max(|x_0|,x_{\rm eq})$ and $g(a,x_0)=\inf_k\bar g(x_k)=1-\max(|x_0|,x_{\rm eq})$.
